status.summary: Welterweight contender, pro record 19-2 (UFC 9-2). Last fought at UFC 328 in Newark (May 9, 2026), beating Joaquin Buckley by unanimous decision (30-25, 30-25, 30-27) with 4 of 10 takedowns and 12:09 of control, a rebound from a first-round TKO loss to Michael Morales at UFC 322 (Nov 15, 2025). He was booked to headline UFC Vegas 124 (UFC Fight Night 293, Meta APEX, Nov 7, 2026) against Gabriel Bonfim but withdrew on Oct 29, 2026 with a staph infection in his left knee that kept him in hospital for three days; Bonfim was pulled from the card. Brady said the UFC told him its Nov 21, Dec 5 and Dec 12 events are full and that he is aiming for the Jan 16, 2027 Fight Night in Dallas, Texas, against Bonfim or a new opponent. Nothing is booked as of Nov 6, 2026.

style.summary: A grappler who wins by getting the fight down and keeping it there. He tries about 8 takedowns per 15 minutes (division 3.75), lands about half, and averages around 500 seconds of control per 15. Standing he throws straight punches and accurate low kicks but has no UFC knockouts. Both of his losses were stoppages by punches at distance against fighters who stopped his takedowns.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 87.0% head, 4.1% body, 8.8% legs, and landed strikes 79.6% head, 6.2% body, 14.2% legs. Career landed is 72.1/6.7/21.2. The body is under a third of the 13.9% welterweight attempt share, so all three body moves stay small. Low kicks get 0.55 in total (calf 0.3, inside 0.25) because they are his most accurate strike (127/145 career) and about 21% of his career landed strikes, even though his last two fights had almost none. ufcstats does not record calf vs inside kicks. 40% of his decayed landed strikes come on the ground, mostly to the head from top position. Ground-and-pound should carry that, and elbow 0.12 stands in for ground elbows, which ufcstats does not separate from punches. The jab/cross/hook split is also not in ufcstats. Straight punches are favoured as a judgment from his distance output, not a count. Spinning is 0 and head kick 0.03 because neither appears in his finishes or the scouting data. The Nov 6, 2026 web pass re-checked status and appearance only; these technique weights still rest on ufcstats alone, with no outside technique breakdown.

engine_notes.note: Takedowns decide his fights: 7.96 attempts and 501 s of control per 15 min decayed (division 3.75 and 167). He landed 0 takedowns in both losses (0/5 Muhammad, 0/1 Morales) and was stopped standing both times. Any knob that lowers his takedown success should raise his KO risk.
Chin: 2 KO/TKO losses in 11 UFC fights, both from punches at distance. 1 knockdown absorbed (Morales); Muhammad stopped him with no knockdown recorded.

Five-round sample is two fights: Burns (W 50-45, 50-45, 49-46) and Edwards (SUB R4). His pace vector (1, 1.24, 0.79, 1.04, 1.48) rests on 5 minutes of round 5. Treat it as noise and use the division prior.

Knee staph infection and a three-day hospital stay in late Oct 2026 cost him the Nov 7 main event. If he fights in early 2027 (he is aiming for Jan 16), any camp-disruption or rust knob applies; no data measures its size.
